title: Security in Christ
definition: Security in Christ is the believer's safety in the saving hand, finished work, and continuing intercession of Jesus.
summary: Security in Christ teaches that believers are kept by the power, promise, and intercession of Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus Christ holds His people, loses none of those given to Him, and secures them by His power.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Security in Christ means believers are kept safe in the saving care of Jesus. Scripture teaches that those who belong to Him are held by His power, promise, intercession, and love.

This security is not permission for careless living. It is the settled confidence that Christ will not abandon the people He purchased and indwells.

Jesus is the secure refuge of His people. No accusation, weakness, suffering, or enemy can separate believers from the love of God in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because fear can make believers live as though salvation depends on constant spiritual perfection. Security in Christ gives assurance while also deepening love, gratitude, and perseverance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Rest your assurance in Christ's grip before examining your own. Fight sin seriously, but do so as someone held by the Savior, and comfort anxious believers with the promises of God rather than vague optimism.
